summary: dsh-config-form provides a unified plugin settings interface for DeepSeek Harness, where adopted plugins expose declarative configuration forms that users can edit from one Settings → Plugins screen.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a unified settings UI component for DeepSeek Harness: it supplies a shared settings tab plus host APIs so adopted plugins can declare fields and have their configuration rendered and edited in one place, rather than building separate pages. The README documents route-driven form discovery, save semantics, and a browser tab integration, while package metadata shows it is packaged as a web-capable DSH bundle. It therefore maps most directly to a navigation/settings panel utility with accompanying API support.
